meta.name: firecrawl-search
meta.description: Web search with full page content extraction. Use this skill whenever the user asks to search the web, find articles, research a topic, look something up, find recent news, discover sources, or says "search for", "find me", "look up", "what are people saying about", or "find articles about". Returns real search results with optional full-page markdown — not just snippets. Provides capabilities beyond Claude's built-in WebSearch.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索网页并提取完整页面内容
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要从网页获取完整内容而非摘要
copy.tagline_en: Search the web and extract full page content
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need full page content from web searches

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以搜索网页并获取完整页面内容（Markdown 格式），而不仅仅是摘要。它还能对搜索结果进行评分和反馈，帮助改进搜索质量。
howto.when: 当你要求搜索网页、查找文章、研究话题、寻找最新新闻或发现来源时触发。例如说“搜索”、“查找”、“找一下”等。

say.text: 搜索关于量子计算的最新新闻
say.note: Claude 会执行搜索并返回结果，可能附带完整页面内容。

say.text: 查找 React Hooks 的官方文档
say.note: Claude 会搜索并提取相关页面的完整内容。

say.text: 找一下关于气候变化的研究论文
say.note: Claude 会搜索并返回结果，可指定来源类型为新闻或网页。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can search the web and retrieve full page content in Markdown format, not just snippets. It can also rate and provide feedback on search results to help improve search quality.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to search the web, find articles, research a topic, look something up, find recent news, or discover sources. For example, saying "search for", "find me", "look up", etc.

say_en.text: Search for the latest news about quantum computing.
Find official documentation for React Hooks.
say_en.note: Claude will search and extract full content from relevant pages.

say_en.text: Look up research papers on climate change.
say_en.note: Claude will search and return results, can specify source type as news or web.
